summary: Volkswagen Auto Lease/Loan Underwritten Funding, LLC, as depositor, and Volkswagen Auto Lease Trust 2026-B filed a routine Form 8-K reporting the September 15, 2026 prospectus for a $991.83 million auto-lease ABS issuance: $148.0 million Class A-1, $291.6 million Class A-2-A, $97.0 million Class A-2-B, $388.6 million Class A-3 and $66.63 million Class A-4 notes. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or equity stake is stated. Mayer Brown and Richards, Layton & Finger supplied legality and tax opinions. The filing is an ordinary shelf securitization takedown, not a special situation; watch pool performance and spread pricing.
